answer.rationale: Use the low-cost quote as a benchmark to negotiate an incumbent renewal that targets the mandated 18% reduction while preserving proven integration and scheduled-delivery stability. With the line at 94% committed volume and only 14 days to expiry, a primary-vendor switch carries unverified transition and delivery risk despite the low-cost vendor's favorable price and prior quick onboarding. Seek multi-year/volume pricing and payment-term concessions; if the incumbent cannot close the cost gap, retain the switch as the next decision path after verification.
